title: Phase6B a P6_retention_mor
text:
Task: build a human MOR (OPRM1) Ki activity model and rank the shared 100k library.

Data:/n- labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprm1/ki/dataset.csv (columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, value_nM, px, label)
- split manifest: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/oprm1/ki/split_manifest.json
- library: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/zinc/library_100k.smi

Steps: rdkit.featurize -> ml.train (xgboost, label source chembl37_ki_pX7_6) -> screening.rank top 100 to runs/MOR_topK.csv.
Deliverable: report ready with the validation AUROC.
note: held-out pitfall variant: must NOT enter the experience store
